evidence.excerpt: We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity.
